name: Disneyland Popcorn Carts & Kat Saka's Kettle Popcorn (Strict Crohn's Hull Warning)
brandOrRestaurant: Popcorn Carts & Kat Saka's Kettle (Disneyland & California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Reference warning: even though Disneyland popcorn smells incredible and is cooked in dairy-free coconut/corn oil, razor-sharp insoluble corn kernel hulls do not digest and can mechanically scrape inflamed intestinal mucosa or catch on strictures.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Buy the souvenir popcorn bucket if you collect them, let family members eat the popcorn, and grab a warm Mickey Pretzel or Churro for yourself instead.
watchOuts: HARD AVOID for Crohn's strictures and flares: sharp, indigestible pericarp corn hulls
